THE LANE
Staff Portal Guide
Start here

WHAT IS THE PORTAL?

The Staff Portal is the club's back office in your pocket. It's a private, password-protected website — separate from the public one — that lets any committee member run Rayners Lane FC from a phone or laptop, with no technical skill needed.

Think of it as the control room behind raynerslanefc.co.uk. When you update something in the portal — a fixture, a score, a news story, a sponsor — it publishes to the real website automatically, usually within about 30 seconds. You never touch code. You fill in a box and press save.

The one thing to understand

One entry → shows in many places

Add a fixture once and it feeds the Fixtures page, the home-page countdown, the fans' phone calendar, Google, and the match-day programme — all at the same time. You do the work once; the portal does the rest.

Two golden truths

1 · It's live

What you save is what the public sees. There's no "draft mode" hiding it — so take a breath before you publish, and you're fine.

2 · You can't break it

Reading and clicking around breaks nothing. Every save is protected so two people editing at once won't wipe each other's work. Explore freely.

The case for it

WHY THIS MATTERS

Most clubs at our level are run from a WhatsApp group and one person's memory. This puts us years ahead — and it only works if the committee actually uses it.

⚡

Look professional

A club that posts sharp, consistent content and live scores looks like it plays three divisions higher. Sponsors notice.

🤝

Win sponsors

Real numbers — fans, reach, engagement — sit in the portal. That's the evidence that sells a sponsorship package.

⏱️

Save time

No more chasing the "website person." Whoever's free updates it in two minutes from their phone.

🧠

One club memory

Minutes, decisions, sponsors, players and history all live in one place — not lost when someone steps back.

💛

Grow the fanbase

Member cards, rewards and match alerts give supporters a reason to come back every week.

📈

Run it like a business

Income, attendance and takings are tracked and charted — so the board makes decisions on facts, not guesses.

The honest ask

A tool only pays off if it's used. If everyone updates their own corner — the manager the squad, the commercial lead the sponsors, the secretary the minutes — the club runs itself. That's the ask today.

THE LANE
Staff Portal Guide
Getting in

YOUR LOGIN

Pete will hand each of you your own login today. Here's exactly how to get in and the rules that keep the club safe.

Step by step — first time

How
  1. On your phone, open the portal link Pete gives you.
  2. Tap "Add to Home Screen" so it sits like an app (Share ▸ Add to Home Screen on iPhone; menu ▸ Install on Android).
  3. Open it from your home screen and enter the access code and your personal password.
  4. You're in — you'll land on the home screen (next page).

Do

Keep your login private · use the portal from your own phone · press save and wait for the green "saved" tick before closing.

Don't

Don't share your password in the WhatsApp group · don't post the access code publicly · don't enter real personal emails or players' private details into public fields.

Roles

Some boardroom tabs (finances, private staff records) are Chairman-only and ask for an extra password. Everyone else sees everything they need to run their area. If a tab asks for a password you don't have, it isn't for your role — that's normal.

⚽ MATCHDAY & CONTENT
📅FixturesAll staff
What
The season schedule & results — the single most important tab to fill.
How
  1. Add each match: opponent, date, time, venue, home/away.
  2. After a game, add the score & scorers.
Why
One entry powers the Fixtures page, home countdown, phone calendar, Google and the programme.
⚽Match DayAll staff
What
The live scoreboard fans see on the home page during a game.
How
  1. Set the opponent, tap "Go Live" at kick-off.
  2. Tap +1 as goals go in — fans update in seconds.
  3. Turn it off at full-time.
Why
Live scores keep fans glued to our page instead of anywhere else.
📄ProgrammeAll staff

The match-day programme notes & preview.
How
Fill the manager's notes & match preview the night before a home game.
Why
Auto-builds a proper printable programme — sponsor value with zero design work.

The post-match write-up that lands on the News page.
How
Type the report + scorers after the game and publish.
Why
Keeps the site fresh and gives fans a reason to check back.
🖼️GalleryAll staff
What
The public photo gallery.
How
Upload match-day & squad photos from your camera roll.
Why

⭐Man of the MatchAll staff

Keep this handy

GOLDEN RULES

The five-step skill

Open a tab → read the yellow note → fill the boxes → press save → wait for the green tick. That's every tab.

It publishes to the real site

Saves go live in ~30 seconds. What you save is what the public sees.

You can't break it

Saves are protected so two people editing at once won't wipe each other's work. Explore freely.

Keep it private

Never share your login or the access code. Never put personal emails or players' private details into public fields.

First-week checklist

  • Add the portal to my phone's home screen and log in.
  • Read the Business Playbook tile end to end.
  • Find my area (squad / sponsors / minutes / social) and make one small edit.
  • Watch it appear on the live site — that's the whole job.
  • Commit to updating my corner every week.
